review_type: Independent read-only review of current/reference instrumented copies against original drivers and helper bodies.
verified: The same official input lengths and 32768/25600 chunk sizes are used.
Current result vector-to-fps temporary conversion and object destruction order are preserved.
FinalStep is declared before Product and records its completed destruction.
Reference Writer -> Product -> Reader destruction and preinit/_exit are preserved.
Each step measures the continuous interval since the previous timestamp; no overlapping or omitted stage was found.
limitations: Current FastOutput construction is in io_setup_header while reference Writer construction is in output_setup; compare both setup phases together.
Current output_setup includes automatic initialization of stack arrays.
Current allocation uses MADV_POPULATE_WRITE; reference lazy arena materialization is charged later to parsing/kernel. Compare complete input/plan groups.
Manual expansion, noinline timer calls, inlining and code layout perturb the executable; compare instrumented whole and unmodified whole.
The analysis driver represents only both lengths >32 and Product::fits, including the official maximum. It is not a general dispatcher.
Independent phase medians cannot be added to obtain an interval median.
